criteria.text: `figures/atlas.ts`'s `mode` accepts `'strip'`; `createHandlers` exposes a `modeStrip` action that calls `setMode('strip')`, tested the same way `modeMap`/`modeColumns` are tested in `test/figures-atlas.test.ts:56-64`.

`render.ts` exports a pure layout function (e.g. `termStripLayout(nodes, personTestimony, width)`) that: includes exactly the nodes for which `termMask(node, personScore) !== null`; excludes every node with `testimony === null`, `testimony === undefined`, or `testimony.n < 3`; excludes every node when `personTestimony?.score` is null/undefined; and, among included nodes, produces `x` values monotonically non-decreasing in `testimony.score`.

The same function widens `domainMax - domainMin` to at least 2 when it would otherwise be smaller, verified with a fixture of exactly one eligible word and with a fixture where every eligible word ties the person's mean.

`render.ts` exports a painter (e.g. `paintTermStrip`) that draws one circle per node the layout function includes, none for any excluded node, each carrying `data-node="<id>"` and an inline `--tone` set to `termMask`'s return value; a dashed line and a `média da pessoa {score}` label appear only when `stats.testimony.score` is not null/undefined; the function returns (or the caller computes) the count of excluded nodes for the hidden note.

`mount()`, exercised through `test/fake-mount-dom.ts`'s `withFiguresDom` (extended with `modeStrip`, `atlasStrip`, `stripHiddenNote`, `zoomGroup`, `keyDefault`, `keyStrip` entries), on `modeStrip.fire('click')`: hides `#viewport`/`#columns`, shows `#atlasStrip`, hides `#mask` and `#zoomGroup`, and paints circles from the currently loaded graph without issuing any new request (same "local repaint, no reload" guarantee `test/figures-atlas.test.ts:56-64` already asserts for the other two mode buttons).

Clicking a circle in strip mode calls the same `choose`/`pick` path a map word click uses (assert via `createHandlers`, mirroring `test/figures-atlas.test.ts:151-176`), and opens `#docsDialog` with a single `sides` entry (`docsQuery` unchanged, `atlas.ts:127-128`), never the two-column layout.
A click on empty space inside `#atlasStrip` releases the selection, verified through `handlers.background` the same way `test/figures-atlas.test.ts:184-196` already covers `#viewport`/`#columns`.

`design-5.html` carries `<button id="modeStrip">Avaliação</button>` inside the same `.segment[role=group]` as `#modeMap`/`#modeColumns`, and a second `<dl class="figure-key" id="keyStrip" hidden>` inside `#workspace` with exactly the four rows Posição/Tamanho/Cor/Clique from the UI section above; the first `<dl class="figure-key">` in `#workspace` (`#keyDefault`) still has exactly `Tamanho/Cor/Posição/Clique`, unchanged, so `test/leitura-ui-acceptance.test.ts:70-80` keeps passing.
`test/figures-atlas.test.ts:345`'s literal match on the segment's closing markup (`...aria-pressed="false">Lista
Every new/changed rule in `atlas.css` uses `font-size: var(--t-*)`, never a px literal (`test/leitura-ui-acceptance.test.ts:119-129` keeps passing unmodified).

`public/como-ler.html`'s `#avaliacao` section states, in plain words, that the strip's word position and figure 1's mask colour are the same kikori number and the same delta-from-mean colour, read by a manual check of that section (no `docsText`/`sourceTable` assertion applies — this is UI copy, not the `docs/*.md` reference `test/docs-drift.test.ts` and the documentation-criterion rule govern).
`pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` pass; `pnpm build` is rerun and `public/bundle.js` committed, so `test/bundle-freshness.test.ts` passes.

`test/atlas-modules-acceptance.test.ts` keeps passing unmodified: the new render.ts exports are used only by `figures/atlas.ts`, nothing in `atlas.ts` reaches into `figures/testimony.ts` or `figures/compare.ts`, and no new template literal feeds `innerHTML` without the `html` tag.
